verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Profile Builder creates customer profiles in the warehouse from identify traits, and lets you define custom JavaScript logic over up to a year of user events, which amounts to code-defined computed traits on profiles. There is no evidence of built-in predictive scores (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) or of using these traits for audience targeting or activation. missing for 10: predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, marketer-facing computed-trait definitions, use of traits in audience targeting/activation, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: You can also define custom logic for profile generation using a JavaScript function, allowing you to leverage up to a year’s worth of user events data.
Profiles are customer records stored in your warehouse, based on the events data you send to Jitsu.
Profile Builder generates profiles based on the `traits` object in `identify` events.
